'''Justin Alfs'''<ref name="dt-20929">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/20929 Moffwicket's Dark Combat], DeckTech (Justin "MoffWicket" Alfs, 28 January 2002). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/20929/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/20929/ GitHub Pages].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''MoffWicket''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Let Them Make The First Move / At Last We Will Have Revenge|Let Them Make The First Move]] list on DeckTech in January 2002.
